name: training
description: Teaching pets to behave, one to one or in classes.

species.description: The animals taken, such as dog or cat.

howDealsGo: A session or a set of sessions is paid into escrow, and the owner releases after each one. Done is the session held; results also depend on practice at home. A timer to the seller, set past each session, pays for sessions held if the owner goes quiet. Before paying, ask how the trainer trains: with rewards or with corrections.
